FIRSTGAME — OPENING VOICE NOTICE

The first 20 lines of PathOfDawn use offline AI-generated Korean narration.
One generic KR narrator is used throughout this preview. These recordings are
not a human cast performance, a voice clone, or an imitation of a named actor.
The Korean story and dialogue are original project writing.

Synthesis: MeloTTS Korean, MyShell.ai, MIT.
Code revision: 209145371cff8fc3bd60d7be902ea69cbdb7965a
Model revision: 0207e5adfc90129a51b6b03d89be6d84360ed323
Model card: https://huggingface.co/myshell-ai/MeloTTS-Korean
Source: https://github.com/myshell-ai/MeloTTS
The model card explicitly marks the Korean model MIT and permits commercial
and non-commercial use. No speech model weights or synthesis service client
are included in the game. Playback uses only the generated Ogg recordings.

Development-only language feature model: kykim/bert-kor-base.
Author repository: https://github.com/kiyoungkim1/LMkor (Apache-2.0).
This model is an offline synthesis dependency and is not distributed in the
player. Reproduction details and all model hashes are in Tools/Voice.
